PetNyam compared the study organization’s public summary with FDA resources to separate reported findings from decisions an individual owner can actually make. Detection is not, by itself, a verdict that your cat’s food is dangerous. This article does not rank brands or claim that PetNyam tested food.

A public r/cats discussion about the investigation included owners expressing frustration. That reaction helps explain why a practical checklist is useful; it is not laboratory evidence, a confirmed illness report or PetNyam’s firsthand experience. We did not use commenters’ medical or brand claims as evidence.

The Clean Label Project summary describes testing 100 products from 62 brands for more than 122 contaminants, using an independent ISO 17025-accredited laboratory. It reports lead detection in 99% of the sampled products. Importantly, it explicitly says detection does not establish danger on its own and that category comparisons are not safety determinations for individual products. 경험의 출처부터 분명히 합니다. 이 글에는 실제 꼬똥 보호자가 2026년 10월 6일 펫냠에 직접 전한 양육 경험이 들어 있습니다. 아래 보호자 메모는 전달받은 내용만 읽기 편하게 정리했습니다. 공개 인터뷰·견종 클럽 자료와 펫냠의 생활 점검 제안은 구분하며, 기록 양식은 실제 관찰 결과가 아닌 빈 도구입니다.
“제가 이 강아지를 키우고 있어요. 활발한데 많이 짖어요. 애견카페에 가면 활발하게 놀고, 사람들이 신기하게 봐요. 나름 착해요.”
